title: A Neural Probabilistic Language Model
finding: Learning word representations and word-sequence probabilities jointly helped neural language models generalize beyond observed sequences.
limit: An early predecessor, not the sole origin of generative AI.

title: Attention Is All You Need
finding: The Transformer replaced recurrent sequence processing with attention and demonstrated more parallelizable training on translation tasks.
limit: Translation experiments do not establish business-report accuracy.

title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners
finding: GPT-3 combined scaled autoregressive modeling, large curated text mixtures and GPU-cluster training, and demonstrated few-shot task performance with limitations.
limit: Historical benchmarks do not measure this organization or a current vendor model.

title: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback
finding: Supervised demonstrations and human preference feedback improved instruction following; the resulting models still made mistakes.
limit: Better alignment with user intent is not a factual-accuracy guarantee.
